WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
with_overall_mean AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_pt,
        avg_iga_igm_diff,
        AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) OVER () AS overall_mean_diff
    FROM patient_averages
),
patient_results AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_pt,
        avg_iga_igm_diff,
        avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(overall_mean_diff, 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM with_overall_mean
)
SELECT
    'patient' AS result_level,
    ID,
    SEX,
    avg_pt,
    avg_iga_igm_diff,
    ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_results
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'sex' AS result_level,
    NULL AS ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
    AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff,
    AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_results
GROUP BY SEX
